meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会把每个 git worktree（和你挑的 PR）当作一个成员拉进共享议事房间，分轮主持讨论，最后自己写出合并汇总，并用大白话说明该以哪个为准、合并顺序和要你拍板的决定。只读，不合并。
howto.when: 当你要求把多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动对比并整理成一份合并方案时，Claude 会接管并主持这个只读议事房间。只有 0 或 1 个候选时它不会开始，只会提示你。

say.text: 帮我看看最近 24 小时活跃的 worktree，整理成一份合并方案
把这些分支和这几个 PR 拉进 standup，看看各自改了什么
say.note: 它会先列出候选清单让你确认

say.text: 汇总一下：该以哪个 worktree 为准，按什么顺序合并？
say.note: 它会写出汇总，并说明要你拍板的决定

howto.what_en: Claude treats each git worktree (and any PR you pick) into a shared markdown room, runs discussion rounds, then writes the consolidation summary: the target worktree, the merge order, and the calls left to you. Read-only; no merges.
howto.when_en: When you ask to compare several worktrees, branches, or PRs and turn them into one consolidation plan. With zero or one candidate it won't run a standup; it will say so and offer to widen.

say_en.text: Look at worktrees active in the last 24 hours and draft a consolidation plan.
Pull these branches and these PRs into a standup and see who changed real code.
say_en.note: It lists candidates for you to confirm first

say_en.text: Summarize it: which worktree should we build on, and in what merge order?
say_en.note: The summary notes the calls left to you
